statements.proposition: This change to memray attach is fully backward compatible with no breaking changes.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: No API-level break found: no public name removed or renamed, no signature changed, and rich is already a declared dependency. But the change alters runtime behaviour (new stderr output, a Rich Status spinner wrapping injection, connection timeout raised from 10s to 30s, and the same spinner now also runs for memray detach via the shared inject_control_channel). Whether any of that breaks a user (for example scripts parsing stderr, or the live TUI) is not settled by a concrete check; tests not run.
